title: Huashi Jiedu Decoction Enhances 5-Fluorouracil Efficacy in Gastric Cancer via miRNA-21-3p/p53 Pathway.
authors: Hong, Qianran; Lin, Weiye; Yan, Yici; Chen, Shuangyu; Li, Jiayang; Yu, Jieru; Zhu, Ying; Qiu, Shengliang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药方剂增强胃癌化疗疗效的miRNA/p53通路机制，仅含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: To explore the mechanism of Huashi Jiedu Decoction (HJD) synergizing with 5-fluorouracil (5-Fu) in gastric cancer (GC) therapy. METHODS: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) and genes involved in HJD-mediated GC treatment were identified using ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometry, network pharmacology, Gene Ontology, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, and molecular docking. The effects of HJD on 5-Fu sensitivity in BGC-823 cells were evaluated with 3-(4,5-Dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide assays, reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), and Western blotting. Synergistic effects in vector-transfected and miRNA-21-3p knockdown cells were assessed by colony formation, wound healing, transwell assays, and flow cytometry (FCM). An in vivo study evaluated the impact of HJD on 5-Fu sensitivity, measuring miRNA-21-3p, tumor protein p53 (p53), N-cadherin, vimentin, and E-cadherin in tumors, along with tumor volume and weight. RESULTS: miRNA-21-3p and p53 were key targets in HJD's therapeutic effect on GC. RT-qPCR showed that HJD combined with 5-Fu reduced miRNA-21-3p and upregulated p53 in vector cells and increased p53 mRNA (p < 0.01) and protein (p < 0.05) compared to 5-Fu alone. These effects were abolished in miRNA-21-3p knockdown cells. The combination reduced colony formation by 48.92% (p < 0.01), suppressed transwell migration by 28.5% (p < 0.01), and inhibited wound healing by 81.9% compared to 5-Fu monotherapy (p < 0.001), with no effects in knockdown cells. FCM showed a 15.1% increase in G(0)/G(1) phase arrest (p < 0.05). In vivo, the combination significantly reduced tumor volume (p < 0.05) and weight by 18.7%, with concomitant miRNA-21-3p downregulation (p < 0.0001), EMT marker suppression (N-cadherin, vimentin), and tumor suppressor activation (p53, E-cadherin) versus 5-Fu alone. CONCLUSION: HJD enhances 5-Fu's effects on GC by regulating the miRNA-21-3p/p53 pathway and modulating cadherin expression, supporting its potential as an adjunctive treatment in GC.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨化湿解毒汤（HJD）与5-氟尿嘧啶（5-Fu）在胃癌（GC）治疗中协同作用的机制。方法：采用超高效液相色谱-四极杆-Orbitrap质谱联用、网络药理学、基因本体论、京都基因与基因组百科全书及分子对接技术，鉴定参与HJD介导GC治疗的微小RNA（miRNAs）和基因。通过3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物实验、逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和蛋白质印迹法评估HJD对BGC-823细胞中5-Fu敏感性的影响。在载体转染和miRNA-21-3p敲低细胞中，通过集落形成、伤口愈合、Transwell实验和流式细胞术（FCM）评估协同效应。体内研究评估HJD对5-Fu敏感性的影响，测量肿瘤中miRNA-21-3p、肿瘤蛋白p53（p53）、N-钙黏蛋白、波形蛋白和E-钙黏蛋白，以及肿瘤体积和重量。结果：miRNA-21-3p和p53是HJD对GC治疗作用的关键靶点。RT-qPCR显示，与单独使用5-Fu相比，HJD联合5-Fu在载体细胞中降低miRNA-21-3p并上调p53，且增加p53 mRNA（p < 0.01）和蛋白（p < 0.05）水平。这些效应在miRNA-21-3p敲低细胞中被消除。与5-Fu单药治疗相比，联合治疗使集落形成减少48.92%（p < 0.01），抑制Transwell迁移28.5%（p < 0.01），并抑制伤口愈合81.9%（p < 0.001），而在敲低细胞中无效应。FCM显示G(0)/G(1)期阻滞增加15.1%（p < 0.05）。体内实验中，与单独使用5-Fu相比，联合治疗显著减少肿瘤体积（p < 0.05）和重量18.7%，同时伴随miRNA-21-3p下调（p < 0.0001）、EMT标志物抑制（N-钙黏蛋白、波形蛋白）和肿瘤抑制因子激活（p53、E-钙黏蛋白）。结论：HJD通过调控miRNA-21-3p/p53通路和调节钙黏蛋白表达增强5-Fu对GC的作用，支持其作为GC辅助治疗的潜力。
